notes.title: Major update February 2020
notes.notes:
The major update is now complete!
Here are the most important changes:

New Endgame Content
A new challenge for hunters, who are looking for an even greater challenge than the gods themselves. Explore the ruins of Crocell and learn more about the Great War.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32960730/658d17a8eeaefdec7c7039778b64790f2a978bc4.png

New cutscenes
Enjoy two openings (start and middle of the game) with the song "The future is lost" by Shearer. experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32960730/c0f8e095989fd721836d42c6fefaed002db6d377.png

New bosses
Various new challenges await throughout the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32960730/f7b8295de5d7214074f623cde6a279ec4f1add1e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32960730/320ebb4b17e847aeed063db379ff98e1a56ecf95.png

New Skills
Discover several new skills and build your heroes even more powerful!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32960730/2dede2eda32c9dd70d9d4fc6aa5e91d4e0670bdb.png

More features
Leave areas whenever you want. Set your own pace - It's much easier to level up in Turbo mode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32960730/901e9733dd3de41a433ea0591e433972d6d2d0aa.png

Various graphical revisions and UI improvements
Various graphics have been refined and were enhanced: more animation frames, revised character sprites, simplified GUI and more. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32960730/7b930d14b64fda0e4586c80d91e86b6034253ffe.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32960730/fe22966ceb107a7474dec0a3a41f4789b3640727.png

notes.title: German translation completed / Minor Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support and motivating feedback. ːsteamhappyː
I hope you enjoy playing as much as I did when I created it.
You can continue to support Hybris - Pulse of Ruin by writing reviews or sharing your gaming experiences with others. I'm looking forward to it!

Important updates:
-The German translation is now finished and finally available. Thank you for your patience!
-Reported bugs have also been fixed and the missing translations have been added.
